children: Copper prices are lower in early Asian trade, with uncertainty over U.S. tariff policy weighing on market sentiment despite tightening concentrate supply, Everbright Futures analysts say in a note. Copper treatment charges have plunged sharply, squeezing smelter margins and pressuring refined copper output, while imports have also weakened, the analysts add. High prices are also curbing restocking appetite, with spot premiums narrowing amid subdued downstream buying, they say. Prices are likely to remain volatile, with the near-term direction hinging on greater clarity over U.S. trade policy, they say. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
